title: Remote clients
text: Run yoke connect with the team server origin. Without company sign-in, choose your own machine for approval by an already connected machine, Enter invite code for a teammate's first machine, or Back without changing connections. An admin creates the code with yoke invite and sends it privately. Non-interactive runs default to own-machine approval; --invite-code-stdin reads a private code. Company sign-in goes directly to personal browser approval. Explicit --token-file and --token-stdin remain available. A local universe is reachable here only; use yoke self-host init to make a reachable team server.
